# Gambetta

Self-hosted from [Fontshare](https://www.fontshare.com/fonts/gambetta) (Indian
Type Foundry). Files here are the `woff2` cuts of 400, 400 italic and 500.

Self-hosted rather than loaded from Fontshare's CDN so the page has no
third-party dependency on the night it matters, and so it works offline.

Confirm the licence terms on the font's page before publishing anywhere public.
